title: Google AI Pro Plans Add A100 and H100 GPU Access via Colab

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 80GB of VRAM are now available to users of Google AI Pro as part of a new bundle of premium Colab benefits. Those who subscribe to Google AI Ultra tiers can access H100 GPUs, providing the compute capacity necessary to run high-end artificial intelligence workloads directly within a web browser.

The available hardware enables the execution and training of larger models in bf16 format, including the Gemma 4 31B model. Users can also perform full fine-tuning up to Gemma 4 E4B, LoRA tuning for Gemma 4 26B A4B, and QLoRA tuning for the 31B version of the model.

selectedTweets.text:
Google AI Pro plans now package premium Colab benefits, landing you A100s with 80GB VRAM (Ultra subs even unlock H100s 🔥).

Here’s what that 80GB headroom unlocks directly in your browser:

✨ Run Gemma 4 31B in bf16
✨ Full fine-tune up to Gemma 4 E4B in bf16
✨ LoRA tune up to Gemma 4 26B A4B in bf16
✨ QLoRA tune up to Gemma 4 31B in bf16
